title: JetBrains Air — Agentic Development Cheat Sheet
brandSub: Agentic tasks · Parallel agents · Cloud runs · Automations · MCP

rows.label: Install (macOS)
rows.value: Download from air.dev; macOS only — Linux via JetBrains Toolbox; Windows planned 2026

rows.label: First launch
rows.value: Connect at least one AI provider before any task can run

rows.label: JetBrains AI sub
rows.value: Single subscription unlocks Claude Agent, OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI & Junie; credits shared

rows.label: BYOK
rows.value: Bring your own Anthropic / OpenAI / Google API key via Settings | Account | AI Providers

rows.label: Open project
rows.value: File | Open for local folder; Git | Clone + repo URL for remote

rows.label: Trust prompt
rows.value: Click Trust to unlock full features; Preview for safer read-only exploration

rows.label: Workspace = project
rows.value: Each project window groups agent sessions, Git state & tools in one place

rows.label: Git required
rows.value: Air needs a Git repository in the workspace to create and run any task

rows.label: Cloud agents (EAP)
rows.value: Run tasks in remote containers at air.jetbrains.cloud — no local clone needed

rows.label: Automations (EAP)
rows.value: Schedule or event-triggered tasks running in cloud — managed on the Automations page

rows.label: Incoming webhooks
rows.value: POST to .../api/v1/events/automations/<id> with Authorization: ApiKey <token> to fire an automation

rows.label: Outgoing webhooks
rows.value: Auto-POST on run finish; Slack hooks.slack.com/triggers/… URLs get flattened slack-workflow format

rows.label: Cloud env lifetime
rows.value: Cloud environment available up to 24 h after task starts, then deleted

rows.label: Plan mode (all agents)
rows.value: Air exposes Plan mode for every agent even if the agent's standalone tool lacks it

rows.label: Voice input
rows.value: Local Whisper model — no audio sent to cloud; download in Settings | Voice Input

rows.label: Review with Agent
rows.value: Dedicated review task runs in a separate agent session; accepted comments feed back as follow-up instructions

rows.label: Task input
rows.value: State goal + what done means — include constraints, expected behavior, known errors

rows.label: Add context (@)
rows.value: Type @ in Chat to attach files, folders, symbols, branches, commits, terminals, or docs

rows.label: Editor selection
rows.value: Select code → right-click → Add to Task to attach exact snippet

rows.label: Upload file
rows.value: Type / → Upload File from Computer to attach logs, screenshots, specs

rows.label: Slash commands
rows.value: Type / to open the slash menu for commands, skills, and review actions

rows.label: Search as context
rows.value: Run a search → Add Search Results to Task to attach matches as context

rows.label: Project instructions
rows.value: CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .claude/ are auto-loaded — commit them to share with team

rows.label: Send / iterate
rows.value: Press ↩ Enter or click Send; follow-up messages refine without restarting

rows.label: Supported agents
rows.value: Claude Agent (Anthropic), OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI (Google), Junie (JetBrains)

rows.label: Select agent
rows.value: Click model selector in task toolbar → choose agent group then model

rows.label: Switch mid-task
rows.value: You can change the model in an active task but not the agent/provider

rows.label: Claude auth
rows.value: Login via Anthropic Console (API billing); Claude Pro/Max/Team not permitted by Anthropic ToS

rows.label: OpenAI accounts
rows.value: ChatGPT Plus/Pro/Team subscription or OpenAI Platform (API billing)

rows.label: Effort / Thinking
rows.value: Set Effort level (Low → Max) to trade reasoning depth against speed & token cost

rows.label: Review model
rows.value: Set a separate model for review in Settings | Global | AI | Review | Agent review model

rows.label: Add agent
rows.value: Model selector → Add Agent → opens Settings | Account | AI Providers

rows.label: Local Workspace
rows.value: Fastest start; agent writes directly to your working copy — no isolation

rows.label: Git Worktree
rows.value: Separate branch + working dir; your main stays untouched until you apply

rows.label: Docker
rows.value: Full filesystem isolation in a container; requires Docker Desktop + valid license

rows.label: Cloud (EAP)
rows.value: Remote container at air.jetbrains.cloud; result committed to task branch & pushed automatically

rows.label: Isolation path
rows.value: Air-managed worktrees live at ~/Library/Caches/JetBrains/Air/tasks/air/<task>/

rows.label: worktree.json
rows.value: .air/worktree.json — set env vars, setup.*, cleanup.* per OS for worktree tasks

rows.label: docker.json
rows.value: .air/docker.json — set image or build.dockerfile, user, environment, setup commands

rows.label: Cloud startup script
rows.value: .air/cloud/startup.sh runs after repo clone, before agent — must be idempotent

rows.label: Plan mode
rows.value: Agent writes plan to .air/plans/ → you approve before implementation begins

rows.label: Ask mode
rows.value: Agent requests approval before each file edit or command; also called Ask Permission / Chat

rows.label: Edit mode
rows.value: Agent edits files automatically with moderate limits; also called Auto-Edit / Agent

rows.label: Full Access mode
rows.value: Fewest restrictions available for the agent — use only for trusted projects

rows.label: Cycle modes
rows.value: Press Shift+Tab to cycle through available permission modes in the task toolbar

rows.label: Plan use cases
rows.value: Multi-file changes, unclear scope, or when you want clarifying questions before code is touched

rows.label: Implement dialog
rows.value: After planning, choose agent/model and run environment before approving implementation

rows.label: Effort selector
rows.value: Click Effort icon in toolbar; higher levels = more reasoning, longer run, more tokens

rows.label: New task shortcut
rows.value: Press ⌘⇧N or click New Task icon to start another task alongside running ones

rows.label: Tasks tool
rows.value: View | Tasks or ⌘1 — see all tasks, states (Running, Input required, Suspended)

rows.label: Input required
rows.value: Task pauses; click Open Task in notification or switch in Tasks tool to unblock

rows.label: Isolated parallelism
rows.value: Use Git Worktree or Docker per task to prevent file-edit conflicts between parallel agents

rows.label: Resume suspended
rows.value: Select Suspended task in Tasks tool → click Resume; send follow-up if needed

rows.label: Group tasks
rows.value: In Tasks tool, click settings icon → group by Date, Status, or Target

rows.label: Task grouping tip
rows.value: Fan out independent subtasks to multiple agents; keep each task bounded & verifiable

rows.label: Cmd palette
rows.value: Press ⌘⇧K to search tools and actions — fastest way to jump between agent sessions

rows.label: Open diff
rows.value: After task finishes, click Changes in Chat to open Task Changes editor tab

rows.label: Diff views
rows.value: Toggle Unified vs Side-by-side in the diff header; hunk navigation controls alongside

rows.label: Add comment
rows.value: Select line(s) in diff → click Add comment → choose Add Comment or Send Comments

rows.label: Send comments
rows.value: Accepted comments become follow-up instructions for the main agent to update code

rows.label: Review with Agent
rows.value: Click Review with Agent in Chat or Task Changes, or type / → Review with Agent

rows.label: Review scope
rows.value: Choose Task Changes, All Local Changes, files/folders, Git commits, or Git branches

rows.label: Project review prompt
rows.value: Override global prompt per repo via .air/review/review-prompt.md

rows.label: Verify result
rows.value: Ask agent to run tests or commands; each iteration refreshes the Task Changes tab

rows.label: Local workspace
rows.value: In Task Changes: enter commit message → click Commit → push to remote

rows.label: Generate commit msg
rows.value: Click Generate Commit Message icon next to Commit button — Air drafts the message

rows.label: Apply Locally
rows.value: From isolated env: Apply Locally copies changes to working copy as uncommitted edits

rows.label: Checkout Branch Locally
rows.value: Apply Locally dropdown → Checkout Branch Locally → creates air/<task>-copy branch

rows.label: Cloud apply
rows.value: Cloud tasks: click Create PR in the task, or open the pushed task branch in your VCS provider

rows.label: Revert single file
rows.value: Changes tool → Task Changes tab → click Revert icon next to the filename

rows.label: Revert all
rows.value: Changes tool → Task Changes tab → click Revert All icon

rows.label: Roll back commit
rows.value: History tool → right-click commit → Reset Current Branch To Here → pick Mixed / Keep / Hard

rows.label: Slash menu
rows.value: Type / in Chat to open — shows built-in commands, agent commands, custom commands, and skills

rows.label: Built-in commands
rows.value: Review with Agent and Upload File from Computer available without config

rows.label: Custom commands
rows.value: Claude: .claude/commands/<name>.md · Gemini: .gemini/commands/<name>.toml · Junie: .junie/commands/<name>.md

rows.label: Shared skills
rows.value: .agents/skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md — available to all agents

rows.label: Agent skills
rows.value: Claude: .claude/skills/ · Codex: .codex/skills/ · Gemini: .gemini/skills/ · Junie: .junie/skills/

rows.label: Skills vs commands
rows.value: Commands are invoked explicitly; skills are loaded by the agent when they match the task context

rows.label: Progressive context
rows.value: Skills keep task context small — agent loads only the workflow it needs, reducing token use

rows.label: Claude settings
rows.value: Shared: .claude/settings.json (version-controlled); personal: .claude/settings.local.json

rows.label: Enable MCP
rows.value: Settings | AI | MCP Servers → toggle Enable MCP support

rows.label: Global MCP
rows.value: Click Add Global MCP Server — available across all projects on your machine

rows.label: Local MCP
rows.value: Add Local MCP Server → stored in .air/mcp.json in project root

rows.label: Workspace MCP
rows.value: Add Workspace MCP Server reuses existing .mcp.json; enable Launch workspace MCP servers

rows.label: Bearer token auth
rows.value: Provide token directly in mcp.json headers.Authorization — env vars not supported

rows.label: OAuth MCP
rows.value: Server appears with a Connect button; click to open provider authorization page

rows.label: Connection status
rows.value: Green indicator + tool count shown in Added list once server connects successfully

rows.label: Use case example
rows.value: Paste a YouTrack issue URL in task → agent fetches details via YouTrack MCP server

rows.label: Web UI
rows.value: Manage cloud tasks and automations at https://air.jetbrains.cloud

rows.label: Connect repo
rows.value: Settings | Integrations → connect GitHub or GitLab; org repos need JetBrains Air app installed by admin

rows.label: VM sizes
rows.value: Small 2/8/20 · Medium 4/16/30 · Large 8/32/50 · XL 16/64/100 (CPU/GB RAM/GB disk)

rows.label: Internet access
rows.value: Off · Specified domains · Trusted domains (preset) · All domains — grant narrowest scope that works

rows.label: Personal secrets
rows.value: Encrypted per-user; exposed as env vars in cloud env; not shared with other users

rows.label: Automation triggers
rows.value: Schedule (At time), Repeat every interval, GitHub PR/Issue events, or Incoming webhook

rows.label: Automation privacy
rows.value: Private (owner only) or Organization (visible to org, editable by owner only)

rows.label: IDE cloud tasks
rows.value: Select JetBrains Cloud agent in AI Assistant in any IntelliJ-based IDE to start cloud tasks

rows.label: Push shortcut
rows.value: ⌃G ⌃P — push local branch to remote tracked branch

rows.label: Pull shortcut
rows.value: ⌃G ⌃U — pull from remote tracked branch into current branch

rows.label: Git Blame
rows.value: ⌃G ⌃A — toggle blame gutter showing revision & author per line

rows.label: Amend commit
rows.value: Git tool → Settings icon → Amend Commit to modify the latest commit

rows.label: History tool
rows.value: Shows Git commits, Before Request snapshots, and Auto-committed task changes on one timeline

rows.label: Branches menu
rows.value: Shows current branch; create, check out local/remote branches, compare & delete from here

rows.label: GitHub token
rows.value: Air pre-fills minimum required scopes — click the generated link when a token input appears

rows.label: Auto-fetch
rows.value: Enable in Settings | Tools | Git | Auto-fetch repositories to stay current in background

rows.label: Go to All
rows.value: ⌘K or Shift Shift — search files, symbols, actions, tools from one popup

rows.label: Find Actions
rows.value: ⌘⇧K — open Actions tab to search and run any IDE action by name

rows.label: Text search
rows.value: ⌘⇧F — search across project with regex, folder scope & file mask filters

rows.label: Go to Definition
rows.value: ⌘B — jump to symbol definition (LSP-backed languages)

rows.label: Find Usages
rows.value: ⌘U — list all usages of the symbol at the caret

rows.label: Go to Implementations
rows.value: ⌘⌥B — navigate to all implementations of an interface or abstract member

rows.label: Next / Prev Problem
rows.value: ⌘E / ⌘⇧E — jump between code problems in the file

rows.label: LSP languages
rows.value: Kotlin, Go, Rust, Python, C/C++, TypeScript/JS family, HTML, CSS, Svelte — full navigation

rows.label: Open Settings
rows.value: ⌘, — Global tab for machine-wide prefs; project tab for workspace-specific config

rows.label: .air/settings.json
rows.value: Excluded paths, custom guide positions, terminal profiles — shared via version control

rows.label: .air/mcp.json
rows.value: Project-level MCP server config — commit to share MCP setup with team

rows.label: .air/review/review-prompt.md
rows.value: Project-specific review guidelines that override the global review prompt

rows.label: Keymap
rows.value: Settings | General | Keymap — choose IntelliJ IDEA, VS Code, or other presets

rows.label: Vim emulation
rows.value: Enable in Settings | Editor — experimental with limited functionality

rows.label: SSH agent forwarding
rows.value: Settings | Tools | SSH — lets worktree/cloud use your local SSH agent without copying keys

rows.label: Terminal profiles
rows.value: Edit "terminal.profiles" array in settings.json to define custom shell profiles
